StahlKids.drive_title: Stahls Essential Psychopharmacology Prescribers Guide - Children and Adolescents (1).pdf
StahlKids.why_this_name: Both Stahl books were labelled with a shared 'Stahl ' prefix, so the model wrote bare 'Stahl p. 761' and no reader - human or code - could tell which of the two was meant. These names share no separable prefix, so 'Stahl' alone is never a valid citation label and is detectable as an error on sight.

Kaplan & Sadock Synopsis.note: Attached as thirds of a 3,768-page book. NotebookLM refuses the whole file — `error` during indexing, no reason given, on two accounts and two uploads — and the largest book that DOES index is Dulcan at 1,677 pages. At 1,256 each the parts go through, verified. `source add` takes the local file, so nothing needs to reach Drive. The edition carries NO printed folios (0 of 7 sampled pages), which is why it is cited by chapter and why splitting cannot shift a page number.
